name: tabcrew-monorepo
description: TabCrew: one local daemon that gives many AI agents their own isolated sessions in your real browser, with Jev-driven browse

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w daemon && npm run build -w relay && npm run build -w cli && npm run build -w extension
scripts.build:store: npm run build -w shared && npm run build:store -w extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w daemon && npm run typecheck -w daemon && npm run typecheck -w relay && npm run typecheck -w cli && npm run typecheck -w extension
